entry_surfaces./: editorial corporate portal — welcome banner top, quick category grid & live appreciation wall feed, action sidebar with demo role switch
entry_surfaces./vtt/new: multi-step VTT wizard — category selector, submission mode (Rahasia/Bernama/Anonim), structured composer, review & confirm modal
entry_surfaces./tiket-saya: split ticket tracker — ticket search / anonymous lookup bar top, filter tabs, active ticket cards with SLA timeline and status chips
entry_surfaces./dinding-apresiasi: bento grid appreciation wall — celebratory badges, filtered by department, heart/cheer reaction triggers
entry_surfaces./hc/moderasi: dense HC moderation inbox — SLA countdown alerts (3-day review / 7-day action), category filter, action modal (Forward to CEO, Publish, Reject w/ reason)
entry_surfaces./ceo/inbox: executive clean inbox — confidential escalated VTT items, direct reply thread, audit log & rejection summary metrics, read-only appreciation link
entry_surfaces./wbs: authoritative whistleblowing overview — confidential protocol guarantee, external portal link, scannable QR verification code
entry_surfaces./hotline-hc: emergency HR hotline center — 24/7 direct WhatsApp QR, quick triage cards (Kecelakaan Kerja, Darurat BPJS, K3), and Google Forms feedback channel
entry_surfaces./cara-kerja: step-by-step workflow blueprint — flowchart of 6 categories, SLA timeline (3 vs 7 working days), privacy & security guarantees

core_principles: Use Bahasa Indonesia exclusively across all UI strings, helper text, toasts, badges, and statuses.
The app style must be Soft Corporate: calm slate background, deep navy corporate anchors (#0F2942), warm teal accents (#0D9488), smooth borders, high-clarity typography.
Implement the complete multi-step Voice to the Top (VTT) flow with reactive validation.
For Apresiasi (Insan Menginspirasi), require the consent checkbox 'Saya setuju apresiasi ini ditampilkan pada Dinding Apresiasi' if approved.
Provide an instant Ticket ID generator (e.g. VTT-2026-0812) upon submission, with copy-to-clipboard functionality.
Support both 'Tiket Saya' (for logged-in submissions) and 'Lacak Tiket Anonim' (search by Ticket ID + Secret Code) so anonymous contributors can check replies and resubmit if rejected.

HC Screen must display SLA status with countdown (3 working days review SLA and 7 working days action SLA), filters (Kategori, Status, SLA status), action modal (Forward to CEO with HC review notes, Publish to Wall for Apresiasi, or Reject with mandatory reason + resubmit flag).

CEO & CHCO screen must display confidential forwarded closed tickets with direct reply threads, read-only link to Appreciation Wall, and an Executive Rejection Recap & Audit Log viewer (showing stats without breaching raw private content).
WBS (Whistleblowing System) page must feature clear corporate governance guidelines, external link button, and a scannable QR code component for mobile reporting.

Hotline Human Capital page must feature 24/7 emergency service triage cards (Kecelakaan Kerja, Darurat BPJS, K3 & Keselamatan Kerja), WhatsApp QR code with pre-filled message generator, and Google Forms employee feedback link.
Cara Kerja page must document the 6 categories, SLA timeline (3 vs 7 working days), privacy & security guarantees, and full lifecycle flowchart.
Provide a top-level Demo Account Switcher in the header or floating widget so evaluators can switch roles (Karyawan, HC Moderator, CEO & CHCO) in one click.
Every interactive element MUST have a `data-testid` attribute (e.g. data-testid='submit-vtt-btn', data-testid='role-switch-hc', data-testid='ticket-status-badge').
Ensure all color pairings meet WCAG AA contrast (minimum 4.5:1 for body and normal text).
